H1, H2, then another H1 creates two sibling top-level groups

```go title="Go"
package main

import (
	"fmt"
	htmd "github.com/xberg-io/html-to-markdown/packages/go/v3"
)

func main() {
	options := htmd.ConversionOptions{
		IncludeDocumentStructure: true,
	}
	result, err := htmd.Convert(`<h1>Chapter One</h1><h2>Section A</h2><p>Section A content.</p><h1>Chapter Two</h1><h2>Section B</h2><p>Section B content.</p>`, &options)
	if err != nil {
		panic(err)
	}
	fmt.Printf("%+v\n", result.Content)
	fmt.Printf("%+v\n", result.Document.Nodes)
}
```
